How do you know when it is over? When the feeling that brought you close to that person and made you want to spend time around him/her is replaced by a sense of constant weariness or anger when you think of or see the person. By your description you have reached this place so now ... the dealing with it.

To get over it, the trick here is to understand where feelings come from and then resolve whatever issue exists. Other people cannot control how you feel, they may be the beginning of the feeling but never the cause.

Let's take the sadness or anger or whatever you feel when you SO cheats on you. These feelings are not caused by his/her actions, they are caused by your inability to accept what happened. Once you understand why and where.. you can begin the heeling process that is accepting and moving on.

The same goes for the end of a relationship. Find out what feelings you have (and remember that they always originate in you and are caused by you) and start accepting a learning from the causes of each of them. When you finish this process you ill be wiser and free. In your case it seems you are unable to accept that a friend would do that to you and the solution seems to be to accept that these people were never your friends to begin with.

In your case I feel their whole attitude is based on jealousy and on the fact that you have the guts to take that step while they are stuck. Still, depending on how much you need to understand, maybe you should ask them why they are sure you will fail and see what insight they might have.
